prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: runtime decorative background texture for a real World of Warcraft addon window, based on the approved TDL classic prototype.
Input image is the edit target.
Primary request: extract ONLY the empty decorative window shell from this design. Preserve the rectangular ornate bronze/gold frame, dark lightly textured stone and leather background, the four corner fittings with rivets, the central inset header plaque and the gold horizontal separator above the bottom editor area. The header plaque should be EMPTY. The main content area should be EMPTY. The bottom editor area should be EMPTY.
Remove ALL text, ALL symbols/icons including the header checklist, ALL checkboxes, ALL task row rectangles and separators, ALL Delete/Add/close buttons, ALL scrollbar and arrows, ALL input boxes, ALL hint text. No controls of any kind baked into the texture. Keep only the gold ornamental divider above the footer at roughly 73 percent of window height.
Composition: straight-on clean game UI texture, whole window shell aspect 5:4. The shell fills the canvas edge to edge as closely as possible; transparent outside its silhouette, no opaque outer backdrop, no wide padding. Solid dark texture inside the window, not transparent interior. Empty header plaque centered at the top is about 25 percent of width and 10 percent of height, seamlessly connected to top frame. Bottom area about 25 percent of height, plain quiet textured dark background. Frame thickness modest, matching the reference.
Constraints: absolutely NO letters, words, icons, tick marks, checkboxes, bars, input fields, buttons, watermarks, shadow outside silhouette or task cards. This is blank window chrome ready for real controls to be placed above it by code.
encoding: RGBA, uncompressed TGA, 1024x1024; cropped to nontransparent content bounds (alpha >= 32) before resizing; original alpha retained; displayed at 600x480.
